options.name: application_pool
options.description: The application pool in which the new site executes.

options.name: hostname
options.description: The host header to bind to / use for the new site.

options.name: ip
options.description: The IP address to bind to / use for the new site.

options.name: parameters
options.description: Custom site Parameters from string where properties are separated by a pipe and property name/values by colon Ex. "foo:1|bar:2" Some custom parameters that you can use are listed below, this isn't a definitive list but some common parameters. C(logfile.directory) - Physical path to store Logs, e.g. C(D:\IIS-LOGs\). C(logfile.period) - Log file rollover scheduled accepting these values, how frequently the log file should be rolled-over, e.g. C(Hourly, Daily, Weekly, Monthly). C(logfile.LogFormat)

options.name: physical_path
options.description: The physical path on the remote host to use for the new site. The specified folder must already exist.

options.name: port
options.description: The port to bind to / use for the new site.

options.name: site_id
options.description: Explicitly set the IIS numeric ID for a site. Note that this value cannot be changed after the website has been created.
